answer_1.quote: We conduct experiments on two sequence-to-sequence (seq2seq) tasks with semantic equivalence between the source and target sequences: paraphrase generation and machine translation.

answer_2.quote: We use the BLEU score to evaluate machine translation performance. For paraphrase generation, we also adopt ROUGE and METEOR, we report iBLEU, and we compute lexical diversity (D_lex) and syntax diversity (D_syn).

answer_4.quote: We ask three annotators to vote for one of the two candidates: hypotheses from the seq2seq baseline and our method. The annotators are required to decide, which one is better by considering Fidelity, Novelty, and Diversity.
answer_4.guideline: Annotators compare outputs side‑by‑side and rate them on Fidelity (semantic equivalence), Novelty (structural modification), and Diversity (difference among beam candidates).
